name: mobile-2k
description: Hypothetical mobile NPU sized from Arm's published Ethos-U85 figures and Vela 5.2.0 Ethos_U85_SYS_DRAM_High: 32x64 output-stationary array at 1 GHz (4.096 TOP/s), SRAM 267 KiB, one 256-bit AXI port to DRAM at 24 B/cycle, 500/250-cycle read/write latency, 64/32 outstanding reads/writes, depthwise datapath 192 MAC/cycle.
